title: Master's red lands on the wrong commit: cancel-in-progress kills the run that would have caught it
description: tests.yml sets cancel-in-progress on every ref. Agents push several commits minutes apart, so each push kills its predecessor's run: 17 of the last 60 master runs were cancelled and never produced a verdict. The breaking commit goes untested and a later innocent commit wears the failure — 3 of the last 5 reds landed on a chore/docs/ci commit. It also blinds .husky/pre-push, whose "last completed run" is usually `cancelled`, not `failure`.
